description: A four-stage envelope — attack, transition, sustain, release — that crossfades between an attack level and a sustain level, with a shape control on each slope

params.text: Sets the attack time, the climb from rest to the attack level
Sets the transition time, the move from the attack level to the sustain level
Sets the release time, the fall from the sustain level back to rest
Sets the attack level the envelope climbs to, -5V to +5V; patching the attack voltage input takes this knob out of circuit
Multiplies the sustain voltage input by -1 to +1 to set the sustain level; with nothing patched to that input it reads 5V, so the knob alone gives -5V to +5V
Attenuates the transition time CV input, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Attenuates the release time CV input, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Steps through the curve of the attack slope: Expo, Linear, Sigmoid or Log
Steps through the curve of the transition slope: Expo, Linear, Sigmoid or Log
Steps through which stage the stage gate output is high during: Attack, Transition, Sustain or Release
Steps through what the attack time CV input reaches: Attack Time on its own, or All Slopes, where it scales every stage at a volt per octave
Turns sampling of the level inputs on or off: Enabled samples the attack and sustain voltages at each gate, Disabled lets them follow the cable
Steps through the curve of the release slope: Expo, Linear, Sigmoid or Log
Opens the gate by hand for as long as it is held

inputs.text: The level the envelope climbs to in its attack stage; patched here, it overrides the attack level knob
The level the envelope settles to in its sustain stage, multiplied by the sustain level knob; unpatched it reads 5V
Modulates the attack time, or every slope together when the A time CV destination button is set to All Slopes, at 384 units of the internal 12-bit control range per volt
Modulates the transition time, through the transition time CV amount knob
Modulates the release time, through the release time CV amount knob
Holds the envelope in its sustain stage while it is high; the release starts when it falls
A rising edge here restarts the envelope from its attack stage without waiting for the gate to fall

outputs.text: The envelope, running between the attack level and the sustain level
A 5V gate, high during whichever stage the SEG gate button has chosen
A gate meant to be patched back into the gate input to make the envelope cycle
A 5V gate that follows the input gate but delayed by the envelope's own timing

notes: the attack voltage input is normalled to the attack level knob: with nothing patched the knob sets that voltage, and patching a cable takes the knob out of circuit entirely.
the sustain voltage input is normalled to 5V and the sustain level knob multiplies whatever arrives by -1 to +1. Unpatched it is a -5V to +5V source; patched it attenuverts the cable.
the envelope output runs between the attack level and the sustain level. Set both of those to 0V and nothing comes out of it however the envelope is triggered.
each of the six buttons steps to the next mode when clicked. Hovering one names the mode and its number; right-click and you can type either to jump straight to it.
this module has no right-click menu of its own beyond Rack's standard one.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the A knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V.
inputs.5:
high above 1.2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.6:
high above 1.2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
